auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN card c ON d.XCL_013 = c.XCL_006
JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE c.XCL_007 = 'junior'
  AND c.XCL_008 > '1996-12-31'
  AND t.XCL_049 = 'credit card withdrawal'
  AND t.XCL_048 BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND t.XCL_055 < (
    SELECT AVG(t2.XCL_055)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.XCL_049 = 'credit card withdrawal'
      AND t2.XCL_048 BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  )
